v22-17.candidate: and now he himself brings charges against her as a pretext, saying: I did not find the tokens of your daughter’s virginity. Yet these are the tokens of my daughter’s virginity. And they shall spread the garment before the elders of the city.

v23-7.candidate: You shall not speak peace unto them, nor words to their advantage, all your days for ever.

v23-22.candidate: And if you vow a vow unto the Lord your God, you shall not delay to pay it; for the Lord your God shall surely require it of you, and there shall be sin in you.

v23-23.candidate: But if you do not desire to vow, there is no sin in you.
